horse.title: Horse tack
horse.menu: Ride the horse, open the Inventory and switch to the mount tab (R2 on a controller). Tack is not equipped automatically.

lines.text: Packed trade goods only; nothing else can be stored on a horse.
A slot stacks 10 or 100 packaged goods depending on their price, or 5 or 50 unpackaged ones (since 1.16).
Load at a stable — the stablemaster offers to load cargo onto the horse — or, since 1.16, move goods across from a wagon.
Calling the horse to you drops part of the load: one player’s 150 salt arrived as 55. Patch 1.16 raised the loss from retrieving a horse.
Healing at a stable can cost carried trade goods too.
A bounty target rides on the horse’s back; you cannot fast-travel while carrying one.

care.does: Moderate Health; can be fed while mounted
Small Health; grows in Pywel’s fields
Full Health and survives one fatal blow; sold at stables
Dropped by the horse: a little Health and Trust
Retrieve and Heal Horse restores full Health
Full Health anywhere; one Abyss Artifact to learn

notes: To feed: ride, open the Inventory, hold Use on the food and choose Feed to Horse. Food heals in steps, so a badly hurt horse needs several.
No five-piece set bonus is documented, so mixing pieces costs nothing.
Refine tack at a Smithy. Extraction (1.06) rolls refinement back: rare materials return in full, common ones at about 70%.
Every registered standard horse takes the same five slots, whatever the breed or coat; the legendary horses wear them too.
A stable will fetch a horse you did not ride there for a delivery fee that grows with distance; 1.16 raised what retrieving a horse or wagon costs.
Since 2.05 mounts can be summoned and ridden at player housing outside villages.
One Games Wiki page swaps the Stirrups and Horseshoes effects; ConsolePulse and the wiki’s own item table agree with the slots above.

wagon.title: Wagon cargo and barding
wagon.menu: Brice handles the wagon at camp: Load Supply to Wagon opens its cargo.

lines.text: No source publishes a slot count for any wagon. The Timberturner mission list orders them Old, Freight, Trading, and the Trading Wagon needs the most comrades.
A slot stacks 10 or 100 packaged goods depending on their price, or 5 or 50 unpackaged ones (since 1.16).
Load at camp through Brice or, since 1.16, at seven Wagon Workshops across Pywel, and move goods between wagon and horse.
Retrieving or losing the wagon costs part of the load; 1.16 raised that loss.
A stolen wagon sells only at a Wagon Fence; it cannot trade.
